title: From extreme weather to agricultural consequences with agentic AI
title_zh: 从极端天气到农业后果：基于智能体AI的农业风险评估

paragraphs.en: Extreme weather is forecast days ahead, yet its consequences for agriculture remain hard to predict: a forecast says where a storm will strike, not which crops will suffer or how much is at risk, and the records that could tell span many sources. We present WxCrop, the first agent that judges agricultural hazards from physically interpretable weather indices examined by causal analysis, and the first that combines weather and agricultural information to predict crop loss reliably for past and forecast dates. We demonstrate it in Florida on hurricanes, freezes and dry heat, with a loss model calibrated on insurance records for each, and the same procedure extends to other hazards and areas. Three checks show reliability: the hurricane index detects recorded cyclone days with an AUC of 0.98, recorded losses in held-out years are reproduced to within 2%, and independent production records confirm the county rankings (rank correlation 0.63). Users ask the agent for each crop group’s loss as a fraction of expected season value, every number sourced, so that governments, growers and scientists respond to agricultural disasters quickly.
paragraphs.zh: 极端天气可以提前数天预报，但其对农业的影响仍难以预测：预报只说明风暴将在何处登陆，而不会说明哪些作物会受损、风险有多大，而可能揭示答案的记录又散布在众多数据源中。 我们提出 WxCrop，这是首个通过因果分析检验具有物理可解释性的天气指标来评估农业灾害的智能体，也是首个结合天气与农业信息、对过去和预报日期可靠预测作物损失的智能体。 我们在佛罗里达州针对飓风、霜冻和干热进行了演示，为每种灾害分别用保险记录校准了损失模型，同样的流程也可推广到其他灾害和地区。 三项检验证明了其可靠性：飓风指标识别有记录的气旋日的 AUC 为 0.98，留出年份的有记录损失再现误差在 2% 以内，独立的生产记录也印证了县级排名（秩相关系数 0.63）。 用户可以向该智能体询问各作物组损失占预期季度价值的比例，每个数字都有来源可查，从而帮助政府、种植者和科学家迅速应对农业灾害。

paragraphs.en: Weather has shaped what people can grow for as long as there has been agriculture, and it still does. Disasters cost world agriculture an estimated US$3.26 trillion between 1991 and 2023, about 4% of global agricultural GDP each year, with climate-related hazards accounting for close to US$2.9 trillion of it, and warming is raising the exposure of staple crops in most producing regions even where farms adapt [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Early warning is among the best-returning defences, with anticipatory action returning up to seven dollars for each one invested [ 1 ] . Yet a warning is only as useful as what it says. A weather forecast tells us what the sky will do; it does not tell a grower, an agency or a scientist what the storm will do to the crops.

paragraphs.en: Consider a hurricane three days from landfall. A grower asks how much of this season’s crop is at stake. An emergency manager asks which counties should receive inspectors and relief first. Both questions concern the same storm and the same crops, and both must be answered before landfall to be useful; today, neither can be. Florida, where we demonstrate the approach, shows the cost of waiting. Hurricane Milton struck the state on 9 October 2024 and cost its agriculture an estimated $428 million [ 6 ] , but the preliminary estimate appeared ten weeks after landfall [ 7 ] and the final one about ten months after [ 6 ] . The official answer arrived long after the decisions it should have informed.
paragraphs.zh: 设想一场距离登陆还有三天的飓风。 一位种植者想知道本季作物有多少面临风险。 一位应急管理者想知道应优先向哪些县派遣核查人员和救灾物资。 这两个问题涉及同一场风暴和同一批作物，而且都必须在登陆前得到解答才有用；而今天，两者都无法做到。 我们在该方法的应用地佛罗里达州，可以看到等待的代价。 飓风“米尔顿”于2024年10月9日袭击该州，据估计给其农业造成4.28亿美元损失[6]，但初步估计在登陆十周后才发布[7]，最终估计则在约十个月后才发布[6]。 官方答案的到来，远晚于它本应支撑的那些决策。

paragraphs.en: The obstacle is not missing evidence but fragmented evidence. Weather reanalyses and forecasts, hydrological models, dated crop maps, growing calendars and decades of production and insured-loss records all exist, but at different scales, formats and dates, and joining them for a given field on a given day takes a specialist. Three groups pay for this. After a storm, public agencies must locate fields that may have been damaged and verify losses quickly enough to direct relief, and the yield and revenue policies of the federal crop-insurance programme on which most growers depend pay only after the loss of each insured unit has been verified on the farm [ 8 ] , and a county’s disaster designation requires a documented production loss of at least 30% of one crop [ 9 ] , so an early, traceable estimate of where and how much crops were damaged shortens the time to payment; UF/IFAS documented delayed planting after recent hurricanes [ 10 ] , USDA identifies repair and replanting costs as reasons for disaster assistance [ 11 ] , and relief itself can take years, with applications for a Florida block-grant programme covering the 2023 and 2024 hurricanes opening in 2026 [ 12 ] . Before landfall, growers need field-specific scenarios showing which crops and how much of their current value are exposed under a forecast storm [ 13 ] , and without them may leave otherwise productive fields idle into the next season. Scientists and extension specialists repeat the same chain of steps for every storm and every enquiry, retrieving weather records, locating parcels, matching crops and compiling exposure figures, before any judgement can be made; they need these steps carried out on request, with the evidence behind each number kept visible, so that their time goes to the decision rather than the data handling.
paragraphs.zh: 障碍不在于证据缺失，而在于证据碎片化。 天气再分析与预报、水文模型、过期作物图、种植日历以及数十年的产量与保险损失记录都已存在，但它们的尺度、格式和日期各不相同，要为某块田地在某一天将它们拼接起来，需要一位专家。 有三类群体为此付费。 风暴过后，公共机构必须定位可能受损的田地，并足够快速地核实损失以便指导救济；而大多数种植者所依赖的联邦农作物保险计划的产量和收入保单，只有在每个保险单位的损失在农场得到核实后才予以赔付 [ 8 ]，且一个县的灾害认定需要有记录表明某一种作物产量损失至少达到 30% [ 9 ]，因此对作物在哪里受损、受损多少进行早期且可追溯的估算可以缩短赔付时间；UF/IFAS 记录了近期飓风后的延迟种植情况 [ 10 ]，USDA 将修复和补种成本列为灾害援助的理由 [ 11 ]，而救济本身可能耗时数年，例如覆盖 2023 年和 2024 年飓风的佛罗里达州整笔拨款计划的申请于 2026 年才开放 [ 12 ]。 在风暴登陆之前，种植者需要针对具体田地的情景分析，显示在预报风暴下哪些作物及其当前价值的多少处于风险之中 [ 13 ]，若没有这些分析，他们可能会让本可生产的田地闲置到下一季。 科学家和推广专家对每场风暴和每次咨询都要重复同样的步骤链——检索天气记录、定位地块、匹配作物并汇总风险敞口数据——之后才能做出判断；他们需要这些步骤能够按需自动执行，且每个数字背后的证据保持可见，从而让他们的时间用于决策而非数据处理。

paragraphs.en: Existing tools look backward. The formal UF/IFAS estimates rest on the Hurricane Composite Intensity Index, which scores observed wind, rainfall and flood depth on agricultural parcels, sums the three scores, and assigns each level a commodity loss rate drawn from producer surveys and past storms [ 6 , 7 ] ; it is computed after the storm, and its additive form cannot represent hazards that compound, although interacting drivers often cause the largest impacts [ 14 ] . Two earlier lines of work give a foundation for an index that compounds. Chen et al. combined a cyclone’s wind and rainfall into one index for the whole event, which reproduced recorded typhoon damage in China [ 15 ] , and field records from Taiwan show that wind coupled with heavy rain, successive events and the length of a crop’s production period govern crop losses [ 16 ] . Neither is computed by day and county or joined to the crops beneath it. Remote sensing is faster but still post-event: USDA overlays satellite flood extent and observed wind and rainfall on the Cropland Data Layer [ 17 ] , a UF/IFAS assistant answers growers’ damage questions from Sentinel-2 imagery [ 18 , 19 ] , and field-scale damage has been estimated from modelled typhoon winds and satellite rainfall [ 20 ] ; imagery needs an overpass and, for optical sensors, clear skies. Empirical studies quantify how heat, drought and compound extremes reduce production at regional to global scales [ 4 , 5 , 21 ] , and recent work uses USDA Risk Management Agency records of insured losses as a proxy for weather-driven crop damage [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] , but at coarse resolution over seasons or years. Where forecast-driven impact models exist, they estimate housing damage [ 25 ] or rank counties by population exposure. In parallel, language-model assistants are also addressing geoscience and agricultural problems conversationally: ClimSight routes questions to climate-model output [ 26 ] , WildfireGPT coordinates retrieval agents for wildfire adaptation [ 27 ] , DisasTeller chains vision-language agents through post-disaster assessment and notes that early errors propagate downstream [ 28 ] , language models have extracted flood records from hazard narratives [ 29 ] , and an assistant integrates NASA tools with agentic search over NASA datasets to provide geoscience information and solve problems [ 30 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 现有工具只能做事后回顾。 佛罗里达大学食品与农业科学研究所（UF/IFAS）的正式估算依赖于飓风复合强度指数，该指数对农田地块上观测到的风速、降雨量和洪水深度分别打分，将三项得分求和，并根据生产者调查和历史风暴数据为每个等级赋予相应的商品损失率 [ 6 , 7 ] ；该指数在风暴过后才计算，且其相加形式无法表示相互叠加的灾害，而相互作用的驱动因素往往造成最大的影响 [ 14 ] 。 两条早期的研究路线为构建一个能够复合计算的指数奠定了基础。 Chen 等人将一次气旋事件的风和降雨合并为一个覆盖整个事件的指数，该指数重现了中国有记录的台风损失 [ 15 ] ；台湾的田间记录表明，风与强降雨的耦合、连续发生的事件以及作物生产周期的长短共同决定作物损失 [ 16 ] 。 这两项工作都不是按天和县逐日计算，也未与下方的作物数据关联。 遥感速度更快，但仍属于事后评估：美国农业部（USDA）将卫星洪水范围以及观测到的风和降雨叠加在作物数据层上 [ 17 ] ，一位 UF/IFAS 助理根据 Sentinel-2 影像回答种植者的损失问题 [ 18 , 19 ] ，还有研究利用模拟的台风风场和卫星降雨估算田间尺度的损失 [ 20 ] ；影像需要等卫星过境，且对光学传感器而言还需要晴朗的天空。 实证研究量化了高温、干旱和复合极端事件如何在区域到全球尺度上降低产量 [ 4 , 5 , 21 ] ；近期研究使用美国农业部风险管理局（RMA）的承保损失记录作为天气致灾作物损失的代理指标 [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] ，但其分辨率较粗，且以季节或年为时间尺度。 在存在预报驱动的影响模型的地方，它们估算的是住房损失 [ 25 ] ，或按人口暴露度对县进行排序。 与此同时，语言模型助理也在以对话方式解决地球科学和农业问题：ClimSight 将问题路由到气候模式输出 [ 26 ] ；WildfireGPT 协调用于野火适应的检索智能体 [ 27 ] ；DisasTeller 将视觉-语言智能体串联起来进行灾后评估，并指出早期错误会向下游传播 [ 28 ] ；语言模型已从灾害叙述中提取洪水记录 [ 29 ] ；还有一个助理将 NASA 工具与针对 NASA 数据集的智能体搜索相结合，以提供地球科学信息并解决问题 [ 30 ] 。

sents.zh: 佛罗里达大学食品与农业科学研究所（UF/IFAS）的正式估算依赖于飓风复合强度指数，该指数对农田地块上观测到的风速、降雨量和洪水深度分别打分，将三项得分求和，并根据生产者调查和历史风暴数据为每个等级赋予相应的商品损失率 [ 6 , 7 ] ；该指数在风暴过后才计算，且其相加形式无法表示相互叠加的灾害，而相互作用的驱动因素往往造成最大的影响 [ 14 ] 。

sents.en: Two earlier lines of work give a foundation for an index that compounds.
sents.zh: 两条早期的研究路线为构建一个能够复合计算的指数奠定了基础。

sents.en: Chen et al. combined a cyclone’s wind and rainfall into one index for the whole event, which reproduced recorded typhoon damage in China [ 15 ] , and field records from Taiwan show that wind coupled with heavy rain, successive events and the length of a crop’s production period govern crop losses [ 16 ] .
sents.zh: Chen 等人将一次气旋事件的风和降雨合并为一个覆盖整个事件的指数，该指数重现了中国有记录的台风损失 [ 15 ] ；台湾的田间记录表明，风与强降雨的耦合、连续发生的事件以及作物生产周期的长短共同决定作物损失 [ 16 ] 。

sents.en: Neither is computed by day and county or joined to the crops beneath it.
sents.zh: 这两项工作都不是按天和县逐日计算，也未与下方的作物数据关联。

sents.en: Remote sensing is faster but still post-event: USDA overlays satellite flood extent and observed wind and rainfall on the Cropland Data Layer [ 17 ] , a UF/IFAS assistant answers growers’ damage questions from Sentinel-2 imagery [ 18 , 19 ] , and field-scale damage has been estimated from modelled typhoon winds and satellite rainfall [ 20 ] ; imagery needs an overpass and, for optical sensors, clear skies.
sents.zh: 遥感速度更快，但仍属于事后评估：美国农业部（USDA）将卫星洪水范围以及观测到的风和降雨叠加在作物数据层上 [ 17 ] ，一位 UF/IFAS 助理根据 Sentinel-2 影像回答种植者的损失问题 [ 18 , 19 ] ，还有研究利用模拟的台风风场和卫星降雨估算田间尺度的损失 [ 20 ] ；影像需要等卫星过境，且对光学传感器而言还需要晴朗的天空。

sents.en: Empirical studies quantify how heat, drought and compound extremes reduce production at regional to global scales [ 4 , 5 , 21 ] , and recent work uses USDA Risk Management Agency records of insured losses as a proxy for weather-driven crop damage [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] , but at coarse resolution over seasons or years.
sents.zh: 实证研究量化了高温、干旱和复合极端事件如何在区域到全球尺度上降低产量 [ 4 , 5 , 21 ] ；近期研究使用美国农业部风险管理局（RMA）的承保损失记录作为天气致灾作物损失的代理指标 [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] ，但其分辨率较粗，且以季节或年为时间尺度。

sents.en: Where forecast-driven impact models exist, they estimate housing damage [ 25 ] or rank counties by population exposure.
sents.zh: 在存在预报驱动的影响模型的地方，它们估算的是住房损失 [ 25 ] ，或按人口暴露度对县进行排序。

sents.en: In parallel, language-model assistants are also addressing geoscience and agricultural problems conversationally: ClimSight routes questions to climate-model output [ 26 ] , WildfireGPT coordinates retrieval agents for wildfire adaptation [ 27 ] , DisasTeller chains vision-language agents through post-disaster assessment and notes that early errors propagate downstream [ 28 ] , language models have extracted flood records from hazard narratives [ 29 ] , and an assistant integrates NASA tools with agentic search over NASA datasets to provide geoscience information and solve problems [ 30 ] .
sents.zh: 与此同时，语言模型助理也在以对话方式解决地球科学和农业问题：ClimSight 将问题路由到气候模式输出 [ 26 ] ；WildfireGPT 协调用于野火适应的检索智能体 [ 27 ] ；DisasTeller 将视觉-语言智能体串联起来进行灾后评估，并指出早期错误会向下游传播 [ 28 ] ；语言模型已从灾害叙述中提取洪水记录 [ 29 ] ；还有一个助理将 NASA 工具与针对 NASA 数据集的智能体搜索相结合，以提供地球科学信息并解决问题 [ 30 ] 。

paragraphs.en: These systems answer from documents, projections, imagery or data catalogues rather than from dated agricultural parcels, and none links a hazard signal on a given day to the crops and fields beneath it. Their adoption also raises trust: users doubt the sources, cannot follow the computation, and fear fabricated answers, a fear grounded in the documented tendency of language models to produce fluent but unsupported content [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] . A tool that is to be adopted must answer all three.
paragraphs.zh: 这些系统基于文档、投影、影像或数据目录作答，而非基于带有日期的农业地块，且没有任何一个系统能将某一天的危险信号与其下方的作物和农田关联起来。 它们的采用还引发了信任问题：用户怀疑数据来源，无法追踪计算过程，并担心答案被捏造，这种担忧源于语言模型已被证实的倾向，即生成流畅但缺乏依据的内容 [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] 。 一个想要被采用的工具必须同时回答这三个问题。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these needs define what an assistant for agricultural hazard assessment has to provide. It must be usable by agencies, growers and specialists alike without technical preparation, so that plain-language requests replace manual data assembly. It must return evidence for any date a user asks about, past or forecast, rather than for a few pre-analysed events. It must apply the same workflow to every storm instead of being rebuilt for each one. And every figure it reports must be traceable to the records it was computed from. To our knowledge, WxCrop is the first workflow to meet these requirements together. In particular, it provides the first county-level weather hazard index for agriculture whose effect on crop loss has been examined by causal analysis and confirmed against independent records. It is also the first system that combines weather and agricultural records into reliable estimates of the percentage of crop value lost, for any date, including forecasts (Methods).
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些需求定义了农业灾害评估助手必须提供什么。 它必须让机构、种植者和专家都无需技术准备即可使用，从而用自然语言请求替代手工数据整理。 它必须对用户询问的任何日期——无论是过去的还是预报的——都返回证据，而不是仅针对少数预先分析的事件。 它必须对每场风暴应用相同的工作流程，而不是为每场风暴单独重建。 并且它报告的每个数字都必须可以追溯到计算所依据的记录。 据我们所知，WxCrop 是首个同时满足这些要求的工作流程。 特别是，它提供了首个农业县级天气灾害指数，该指数对农作物损失的影响已经过因果分析检验，并与独立记录相互印证。 它也是首个将天气与农业记录结合起来、针对包括预报在内的任何日期可靠估计农作物价值损失百分比（方法）的系统。

paragraphs.en: We present WxCrop (weather × \times crop), an interactive assistant that connects county-level hazard signals with the agricultural evidence behind them, built to meet these requirements. It joins public weather records and forecasts with dated crop maps, growing calendars and insured-loss records, so that every analysis can run for a past storm or for one still offshore. For a chosen date and hazard, the map shows the weather inputs that drive that hazard and a weather-only index for it, alongside the crops, their growth stage and vulnerability. The assistant answers each user’s question with a dedicated product: for decision makers, a hazard index computed from the weather alone that places a county in a tier anchored in how often such weather has been followed by loss; for growers, the fraction of each crop’s expected season value likely to be lost and the probability that a loss occurs at all; for scientists, the harmonised records behind both. Each answer is built to be trusted: every input is a named public record, the index decomposes into its terms, the percentages come from a calibrated model rather than from the language model, and the conversational agent retrieves and explains these figures rather than generating them. We demonstrate the assistant through a case study of Hurricane Ian that follows the three steps a user takes, from the weather and crops on the map, to the hazard index, to the loss estimate, and we then check the answers against recorded losses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 WxCrop（weather × \times crop），这是一个交互式助手，将县级灾害信号与其背后的农业证据联系起来，专为满足这些需求而构建。 它将公开的天气记录和预报与带有日期的作物地图、生长日历和承保损失记录相结合，使每项分析都能针对过去的某场风暴或仍在海上的某场风暴运行。 对于选定的日期和灾害，地图会显示驱动该灾害的天气输入及其仅基于天气的指数，以及作物、其生长阶段和脆弱性。 该助手用专门的产品回答每个用户的问题：对决策者而言，是仅由天气计算得出的灾害指数，该指数将一个县划入某个层级，层级依据是这类天气之后紧随损失出现的频率；对种植者而言，是每种作物预期季度价值中可能损失的比例以及发生损失的概率；对科学家而言，是两者背后的统一化记录。 每个答案都被构建为可信赖的：每个输入都是命名的公开记录，该指数可分解为各项术语，百分比来自经过校准的模型而非语言模型，对话式智能体会检索并解释这些数字而不是生成它们。 我们通过对飓风伊恩（Hurricane Ian）的案例研究来演示该助手，该研究遵循用户采取的三个步骤，从地图上的天气和作物，到灾害指数，再到损失估计，然后我们将答案与记录的损失进行核对。

paragraphs.en: In its first step, WxCrop lets the user choose a hazard in a panel (Fig. 1 a). The panel then offers the weather layers that drive that hazard, selected by causal analysis of insured losses (next section). For the hurricane these are wind and seven-day rainfall. Ticking a layer and a date, here 28 September 2022, loads it on demand from public archives, on its native grid or as county values, reconstructing the conditions of that day. For wind, WxCrop switches source with the weather. On days a tropical cyclone puts at least 10 m s -1 on Florida, the layer is the storm’s wind field reconstructed from the National Hurricane Center best track (Fig. 1 b), because gridded analyses and forecasts smooth the cores of tropical cyclones and underestimate their winds. On other days it is the daily maximum gust from analyses. The same best-track field feeds the hazard index, and the assistant flags forecast winds as such. Layers cover 2004 to the present and, using blended forecast guidance, the coming week. Each layer states its source, its grid and whether its values are observed, analysed or forecast, so that every colour can be traced back to a record. The colour boundaries of each layer are percentiles of its own historical values, from the median to the 99th, so that a colour means the same degree of unusualness on any date, with storm-class boundaries for the best-track wind field (Methods).

paragraphs.en: Clicking a parcel (Fig. 1 e,f) opens a popup with the parcel’s crop, its representative growth stage on the selected date from a growing calendar, and a vulnerability percentage: the fraction of the parcel’s expected season value that has accrued, and is therefore exposed, on that date. For an annual crop it is the seasonal progress, floored at the establishment cost already sunk on planting day. The tomato field in Fig. 1 f, about 27 of 90 days after its calendar planting date, stands at 30%. For citrus the fruit progress is computed in the same way, the days elapsed since bloom divided by the days to maturity, bounded by the fastest and slowest cultivars, and added to the standing value of the trees, so that the grove in Fig. 1 e shows a range, 86% to 99.8%, which stays below the full crop until harvest begins. The rules for each crop type are in the code repository ( docs/PARCEL_VULNERABILITY_RULES.md ). Vulnerability has two parts: the cost already invested, which is the value of the trees for perennial crops and the establishment cost for annual crops once planted, and the calendar fraction of the season’s expected income, an opportunity cost that grows toward harvest. A citrus grove therefore carries at least the value of its trees throughout the year, including outside the harvest season, and a cotton field in November is mostly harvested and contributes little. This vulnerability percentage is a sourced indicator, built on growing calendars compiled from UF/IFAS crop guides and USDA statistics, of how vulnerable each parcel is on the selected date.
paragraphs.zh: 点击某个地块（图1 e,f）会打开一个弹窗，显示该地块的作物、其在所选日期根据生长日历所处的代表性生长阶段，以及一个脆弱性百分比：即在该日期，地块预期季节价值中已经累积、因而处于风险之中的部分。 对于一年生作物，该百分比即季节进度，并以播种日已投入的建植成本作为下限。 图1 f 中的番茄田，按其日历播种日期算起约27天（共90天），其比例为30%。 对于柑橘，果实进度以相同方式计算，即自开花起经过的天数除以成熟所需天数，并受最快与最慢品种的界限约束，再加上果树本身的既有价值，因此图1 e 中的果园显示为一个区间，即86%至99.8%，在收获开始之前一直低于作物的全部价值。 每种作物类型的规则见代码仓库（ docs/PARCEL_VULNERABILITY_RULES.md ）。 脆弱性由两部分组成：一是已投入的成本，即多年生作物的果树价值和一年生作物播种后的建植成本；二是季节预期收入的日历比例，即随收获临近而增长的机会成本。 因此，柑橘园全年至少承载着果树的价值，包括收获季节之外的时间；而11月的棉花田大多已收获完毕，贡献很小。 该脆弱性百分比是一个有出处的指标，基于由 UF/IFAS 作物指南和 USDA 统计数据汇编的生长日历构建，用以衡量每个地块在所选日期的脆弱程度。

paragraphs.en: Everything on the map can also be asked about in plain language, at the scale the user needs: a single parcel, the current view, a county or a named place. A user can equally ask which crops dominate a county, how much citrus has been lost to decline, what growth stage cotton has reached on a given date, or how much rain fell on a grove in the previous seven days. The assistant also makes the map convenient to operate: it selects the hazard from the question, moves the map, sets the date and opens a county, so that a question is enough to reach the answer.

paragraphs.en: From the weather layers of each hazard alone, WxCrop computes a composite hazard index that shows how unusual the weather was and rises with the damage it does, for any county on any day for which the weather inputs exist, and adds it to the map as a new layer. For hurricanes this is the hurricane hazard index, H H , and its design follows the physics of the damage. Strong wind together with heavy rain loads wet soil and plants more than either alone, because trees in saturated soil lose much of their resistance to overturning [ 34 ] , and drivers that act together often cause the largest impacts [ 14 ] . To find which factors matter for H H , and which physically plausible interactions between them are present, we examined the commonly used weather quantities linked to hurricane damage, among them wind speed and duration, rainfall, ponding and wet hours, water tables, soil drainage, the interval since the previous storm and tree age. Each was tested against insured losses by causal analysis, with the candidates and the acceptance rules fixed before the results were seen. Wind and rainfall mattered, and so did their interaction, while the other candidates repeated these two, showed no signal or lacked data (Methods). H H therefore multiplies a wind load, which grows with the square of the sustained wind as dynamic pressure does, by an amplifier that grows with rainfall (equation 1 ). Of eight pre-specified forms, this one matched recorded storm days and independent loss reports best.
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭每种灾害的天气图层，WxCrop 即可计算出一个综合灾害指数，用以显示天气的异常程度，且该指数随其造成的损害而上升，适用于存在天气输入数据的任何县、任何一天，并将其作为新图层添加到地图中。 对飓风而言，这就是飓风灾害指数 H H，其设计遵循损害的物理规律。 强风与强降雨共同作用时，对湿润土壤和植物的负荷比二者单独作用时更大，因为饱和土壤中的树木会失去大部分抗倒伏能力 [34]，而协同作用的驱动因素往往会造成最大的影响 [14]。 为了找出哪些因素对 H H 有影响，以及这些因素之间存在哪些物理上合理的相互作用，我们考察了与飓风损害相关的常用天气量，其中包括风速与持续时间、降雨量、积水和湿润时长、地下水位、土壤排水、距上一场风暴的时间间隔以及树龄。 每个因素都通过因果分析对照保险损失进行了检验，候选因素和接受规则在看到结果之前就已固定。 风和降雨量有影响，它们的相互作用也有影响，而其他候选因素要么重复了这两个因素，要么没有信号，要么缺乏数据（方法部分）。 因此，H H 将随持续风速的平方而增长的风载荷（正如动压那样）与一个随降雨量而增长的放大因子相乘（公式 1）。 在八种预先指定的形式中，这一形式与记录的风暴日和独立的损失报告匹配得最好。

sents.zh: 仅凭每种灾害的天气图层，WxCrop 即可计算出一个综合灾害指数，用以显示天气的异常程度，且该指数随其造成的损害而上升，适用于存在天气输入数据的任何县、任何一天，并将其作为新图层添加到地图中。

sents.en: For hurricanes this is the hurricane hazard index, H H , and its design follows the physics of the damage.
sents.zh: 对飓风而言，这就是飓风灾害指数 H H，其设计遵循损害的物理规律。

sents.en: Strong wind together with heavy rain loads wet soil and plants more than either alone, because trees in saturated soil lose much of their resistance to overturning [ 34 ] , and drivers that act together often cause the largest impacts [ 14 ] .
sents.zh: 强风与强降雨共同作用时，对湿润土壤和植物的负荷比二者单独作用时更大，因为饱和土壤中的树木会失去大部分抗倒伏能力 [34]，而协同作用的驱动因素往往会造成最大的影响 [14]。

sents.en: To find which factors matter for H H , and which physically plausible interactions between them are present, we examined the commonly used weather quantities linked to hurricane damage, among them wind speed and duration, rainfall, ponding and wet hours, water tables, soil drainage, the interval since the previous storm and tree age.
sents.zh: 为了找出哪些因素对 H H 有影响，以及这些因素之间存在哪些物理上合理的相互作用，我们考察了与飓风损害相关的常用天气量，其中包括风速与持续时间、降雨量、积水和湿润时长、地下水位、土壤排水、距上一场风暴的时间间隔以及树龄。

sents.en: Each was tested against insured losses by causal analysis, with the candidates and the acceptance rules fixed before the results were seen.
sents.zh: 每个因素都通过因果分析对照保险损失进行了检验，候选因素和接受规则在看到结果之前就已固定。

sents.en: Wind and rainfall mattered, and so did their interaction, while the other candidates repeated these two, showed no signal or lacked data (Methods).
sents.zh: 风和降雨量有影响，它们的相互作用也有影响，而其他候选因素要么重复了这两个因素，要么没有信号，要么缺乏数据（方法部分）。

sents.en: H H therefore multiplies a wind load, which grows with the square of the sustained wind as dynamic pressure does, by an amplifier that grows with rainfall (equation 1 ).
sents.zh: 因此，H H 将随持续风速的平方而增长的风载荷（正如动压那样）与一个随降雨量而增长的放大因子相乘（公式 1）。

sents.en: Of eight pre-specified forms, this one matched recorded storm days and independent loss reports best.

paragraphs.en: Freezes and dry heat follow the same design. Each hazard has its own weather layers and an index built from them in the same way. For freezes the layers are the night’s minimum temperature and cloud cover, and the index is the depth of the minimum below each farmland cell’s design temperature, amplified under clear skies, which govern radiative cooling. For dry heat the layers are a standardised 120-day deficit of precipitation relative to evapotranspiration and the heat accumulated above 32 ∘ C over the preceding 30 days, and the index is the deficit amplified by that heat. The freeze index is computed for each night, and the dry-heat index accumulates over the growing season. Their inputs were selected by the same protocol (Methods). Their tier boundaries are fixed thresholds set in the same way as those of H H , from the exposed records: for freezes the median, 90th and 97th percentiles of the county-months in which the night fell below the design temperature, and for dry heat the median, upper quartile and top decile of insured field-crop county-seasons.
paragraphs.zh: 冻害和干热遵循相同的设计。 每种灾害都有自己的天气图层，并以相同方式由这些图层构建一个指数。 对于冻害，图层是夜间最低温度和云量，指数是最低温度低于每个农田单元设计温度的深度，在晴朗天空下（这主导辐射冷却）会被放大。 对于干热，图层是相对于蒸散量的标准化120天降水亏缺以及此前30天累积的32°C以上热量，指数是该热量放大的降水亏缺。 冻害指数每晚计算一次，干热指数在整个生长季累积。 它们的输入由同一方案（方法）选定。 它们的层级边界是固定的阈值，与 H H 的层级边界以相同方式从暴露记录中设定：冻害取夜间低于设计温度的县-月份的中位数、第90和第97百分位数，干热取有保险的大田作物县-季的中位数、上四分位数和最高十分位数。

paragraphs.en: The hazard tier decides what the assistant does next. If the index falls in the lowest tier, as it does for Jackson County on the case day, the assistant tells the user that the day matches one without that hazard and that insured crop losses stay at their background level; the answer ends at the tier, because for such days an estimate would sit at the background and lend false precision to a non-event (Fig. 3 a). If the index is higher, the assistant treats the day as a disaster of that kind and takes everything from the first step as inputs: which crops are present in the county, their growth stage on that day, and their vulnerability. These enter the loss model calibrated for that hazard, which returns the expected loss of each crop group as a percentage of its expected season value.
paragraphs.zh: 危害等级决定了智能体下一步的行动。 如果指数落在最低等级——正如案例日的杰克逊县那样——智能体会告诉用户当天与一次未发生该危害的日子相匹配，投保作物损失保持在背景水平；答案到等级为止，因为对于这类日子，任何估计都会停留在背景水平上，从而给一个未发生的事件赋予虚假的精确性（图 3 a）。 如果指数更高，智能体会把该日视为该类灾害，并将第一步的所有内容作为输入：该县存在哪些作物、它们当天的生长阶段以及它们的脆弱性。 这些信息进入针对该危害校准的损失模型，模型返回每个作物组的预期损失，以其预期季度价值的百分比表示。

paragraphs.en: How strongly a hazard affects a crop depends mainly on two factors. One is the susceptibility θ g \theta_{g} of crop group g g , how sensitive that crop is to the kind of hazard, which differs between crops and between hazards: wind strikes cotton hard and sugarcane hardly at all, and drought hits peanuts while irrigated citrus responds little. The other is its yield vulnerability on the day, φ g \varphi_{g} , the fraction of the season’s yield that is in the field. It is the vulnerability above without its fixed part, the value of the trees, which lies outside what crop insurance pays for and is unrelated to the percentage loss of the season’s yield that we aim to predict. Citrus stands in the field all year, whereas vegetables in late September have only part of their season in the field, so the same storm costs them less. For DeSoto County, in the severe tier, the loss model combines them with the index into two quantities for each crop group (Fig. 3 b): the loss fraction S g S_{g} expected if damage occurs, which rises with the index, θ g \theta_{g} and φ g \varphi_{g} , and the probability P g P_{g} that insured growers of that group receive any payout, the insurer’s payment for a loss, in the month, because many county-months with moderate hazard end without a payout. Their product, the expected loss L g = P g ​ S g L_{g}=P_{g}S_{g} , is the quantity the assistant reports. Both refer to the insured units of the crop group, the scale on which the model was calibrated (Methods). The index is taken as its largest daily value in the 30 days that end on the selected date (the season to date for dry heat), which follows the insured losses used to calibrate the model: they are recorded by month and, once incurred, stay in the monthly record, so that the estimate holds at its peak as the storm passes instead of falling back day by day. For citrus S g S_{g} and P g P_{g} are 83% and 98%, an expected loss of 82% of the season’s expected value. Percentages are county-level values for each crop group, which match the scale of the insured-loss records used to calibrate them.

A user who asks about a hurricane, a freeze or a dry season receives the crops at risk, how much of their value is likely to be lost, how likely that loss is, and where each number comes from. paragraphs.en: The hazard indices and percentage losses WxCrop returns are advisory estimates, meant to show a user how severe a hazard is likely to be for each crop group and where to look first, and this section shows their validity at that level. Such a test needs loss labels that can be tied to the weather that caused them, and we assembled these ourselves: insured-loss records separated by the recorded cause of loss at the scale of county, crop group and month, with independent records alongside. Against these we will show two things in turn: that the three hazard indices detect and order the hazards they stand for, and that the loss model reproduces the insured losses it was calibrated on, agrees in ranking with records from outside the insurance data and returns a calibrated probability of a payout (Fig. 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: WxCrop 返回的危害指数和损失百分比属于参考性估计，旨在向用户展示每种危害对各作物群体可能有多严重，以及应首先从哪里着手查看，本节即在该层面上验证其有效性。 这类检验需要能与致灾天气相关联的损失标签，这些标签由我们自行整理：按县、作物群体和月份的尺度，依据记录的损失原因对保险损失记录进行分类，并同时附有独立的记录。 针对这些数据，我们将依次展示两点：三个危害指数能够检测并排列其所代表的危害，损失模型能够再现其校准所依据的保险损失，在与保险数据之外的记录的排序上保持一致，并给出经过校准的赔付概率（图 4）。

paragraphs.en: First, to show that the hazard indices detect the hazards they stand for, we use the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) [ 35 ] , the probability that a randomly chosen day with a recorded event receives a higher index than a randomly chosen day without one, which is 0.5 for a random score and 1 for a perfect one. These reference records contain no crop information. The hurricane index H H separates recorded tropical-cyclone days from other days with an AUC of 0.98 (Fig. 4 a), and the test of its ordering was given above, where insured losses rise with its tier (Fig. 2 e). The freeze index separates recorded freeze days from other days with an AUC of 0.99, and insured freeze losses rise with its tier, from 2% of winter county-months without a freeze to 78% in the highest tier, with 53% above $100,000 (Fig. 4 b). The dry-heat index separates seasons with severe drought in the U.S. Drought Monitor with an AUC of 0.76 for the season to date, which looks modest as a number but is good agreement with a reference that blends several drought indicators and follows slow deficits more closely than crop losses (Methods), and across its tiers the proportion of insured field-crop county-seasons with a payout above $100,000 rises from 24% to 74% and the proportion of seasons with severe drought from 6% to 64% (Fig. 4 c).
paragraphs.zh: 首先，为了表明这些风险指数确实能检测出其所代表的风险，我们使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）[35]，即随机抽取的一个有记录事件的日子其指数高于随机抽取的一个无事件日子的概率，随机评分对应 0.5，完美评分对应 1。 这些参考记录不含作物信息。 飓风指数 H H 以 0.98 的 AUC 将有记录的热带气旋日子与其他日子区分开来（图 4 a），其排序能力的检验已在上面给出，即投保损失随其层级上升（图 2 e）。 冰冻指数以 0.99 的 AUC 将有记录的冰冻日子与其他日子区分开来，投保的冰冻损失随其层级上升，从无冰冻的冬季县-月的 2%上升到最高层级的 78%，其中 53%超过 10 万美元（图 4 b）。 干热指数将以美国严重干旱季节划分的 Drought Monitor 为参照，对本季节至今的 AUC 为 0.76，这个数字看似不高，但与一个融合多种干旱指标、比作物损失更紧密地跟随缓慢亏缺的参照标准相比，已是相当好的吻合（方法），并且在其各层级之间，赔付超过 10 万美元的投保田间作物县-季节的比例从 24%上升到 74%，严重干旱季节的比例从 6%上升到 64%（图 4 c）。

paragraphs.en: The ranking of the percentages also agrees with independent records, which include uninsured growers. paragraphs.en: Earlier work approaches the question from three sides. Conversational assistants have begun to answer agricultural questions: ClimSight draws on climate projections and a location’s soil, land use and crop requirements to advise whether a crop suits a place in the decades ahead, with the language model reasoning from the retrieved material to the answer [ 26 ] . Weather-only indices describe the hazard. The Hurricane Composite Intensity Index behind the UF/IFAS estimates adds the level numbers of wind, rainfall and flood depth, so that the sum carries no interaction and cannot tell its terms apart, a parcel under strong wind, heavy rain and shallow ponding scoring the same as one under strong wind, light rain and deep ponding, and the published reports present no test of it against recorded losses [ 38 , 6 ] . The compound index of Chen et al. [ 15 ] , on which the multiplicative form here builds, is an event total from station sums checked against provincial disaster statistics, the Taiwan field evidence [ 16 ] is a tabulation of loss area by event type, and other weather-only indices rank cyclones for property by wind, size and speed [ 39 ] , so none gives the intensity at one county on one day or from a forecast. Loss models built on the insurance records take one hazard with one or a few crops and report coefficients or predictions for a county by year, season or month, and none inverts the deductible structure to recover the damage fraction from the payout or compares a hazard-specific loss with independent production records of the same events [ 40 , 41 , 22 , 42 , 24 , 23 ] . WxCrop improves each and joins them. Its compound indices are computed for every county and day, past or forecast, and chosen by causal analysis among physically plausible interacting factors, wind with rain for hurricanes, cold with clear skies for freezes and deficit with heat for dry heat.
paragraphs.zh: 早前的研究从三个方面探讨这一问题。 对话式助手已开始回答农业问题：ClimSight 利用气候预测以及某地的土壤、土地利用和作物需求，就某种作物在未来几十年是否适合某地给出建议，语言模型则从检索到的材料推理得出答案 [ 26 ] 。 仅基于天气的指数描述的是灾害本身。 UF/IFAS 估算背后的飓风复合强度指数将风、降雨和洪水深度的等级数值相加，因而总和不含交互作用，也无法区分各分量：强风、大雨和浅积水的一块土地，与强风、小雨和深积水的一块土地得分相同，而已发表的报告未对该指数与实际记录损失进行过检验 [ 38 , 6 ] 。 Chen 等人的复合指数 [ 15 ] 是本文乘法形式的基础，它是根据台站求和并经省级灾害统计校验的事件总量；台湾的田间证据 [ 16 ] 是按事件类型整理的损失面积表格；其他仅基于天气的指数则按风、规模和速度对气旋的财产影响进行排序 [ 39 ] ，因此这些指数都不能给出某一县某一天的强度，也不能用于预报。 基于保险记录构建的损失模型只针对一种灾害和一种或少数几种作物，按县、年、季或月报告系数或预测值，且没有任何模型反推免赔额结构以从赔付金额中还原损失比例，或将特定灾害的损失与同一事件的独立生产记录进行比较 [ 40 , 41 , 22 , 42 , 24 , 23 ] 。 WxCrop 对上述各方面逐一改进并将其结合起来。 它的复合指数为每个县、每一天（无论是过去还是预报）计算，并通过因果分析从物理上合理且存在交互作用的因子中选取：飓风取风与雨的组合，霜冻取低温与晴空的组合，干热则取缺水与高温的组合。

paragraphs.en: Its loss models answer the limits of the insurance-based studies one by one: every crop group has its own susceptibility to each of the three hazards, the loss is that of a given day, obtained from the index of that day and the crop’s growth stage on it rather than from a coefficient or a prediction for a year, season or month, the damage fraction is recovered from the payout by the inversion described in Methods, which finds for each county, commodity and month the damage that would have produced the recorded payout under the deductibles held, and the result is checked against independent production records of the same events (Results). Its assistant operates these models and relays their results with their sources, in place of reasoning from retrieved text. It is therefore the first assistant to carry a weather hazard through calibrated crop-loss models to the parcels beneath it.

paragraphs.en: Because the layers are connected and each stands on its own evidence, one answer serves users at the depth each needs: a specialist can open any layer and find the sourced records behind it, with the assistant assembling them on request, and a grower, an emergency manager or an agency can take the tier and the percentages as directional guidance, which crops to protect first, which counties to send inspectors and relief to first, without reading the layers beneath.
paragraphs.zh: 因为各层级相互连接，且每一层都有其独立的证据支撑，所以同一个答案能够以每位用户所需的深度为其服务：专家可以打开任意一层，找到其背后有据可查的记录，由助手按需进行汇总整合；而种植者、应急管理人员或机构则可以将该层级及其百分比视为方向性指导——先保护哪些作物、先向哪些县派遣检查员和提供救济——而无需阅读其下的各层内容。

paragraphs.en: For a hazard still ahead, the same indices run on seven-day forecast inputs, the National Blend of Models for wind, rain, temperature and cloud, and when the National Hurricane Center issues advisories for a storm, its forecast track and wind radii replace the blended wind, so that the forecast index gains accuracy as these event-specific forecasts arrive. Several uses follow from this design and remain to be measured. Agencies can locate fields for verification and order relief from the tier and crop groups of each county, growers can compare scenarios under a forecast storm, and insurers can anticipate payouts by crop group. In each case the percentages serve as a reference that field verification then refines.

paragraphs.en: Absolute dollar loss is the hardest output because no public record states it at a level that could serve as a label: insurance files record payouts, the payments after deductibles to the insured growers, post-storm reports give preliminary county estimates, and disaster programmes record payments rather than losses, and earlier studies share this difficulty. These records support percentages far better than precise dollar analysis, and for users who need a dollar figure the model also predicts one on request, at the level of an order of magnitude with its stated accuracy: for the 215 county-months with recorded payouts above $100,000, the retrospective model fell within a factor of ten of the payout in 92% of cases and within a factor of five in 81%, the daily estimate in 83% and 66%, and for moderate events the daily estimate was typically below a quarter of the payout. The percentage of expected season value remains the primary answer, because it can be checked against the insurance records from which it was calibrated, whereas a dollar figure adds exposure data and prices whose errors compound it.
paragraphs.zh: 绝对美元损失是最难给出的输出，因为没有任何公开记录能在可作为标签的层面给出该数值：保险档案记录的是赔付金额，即扣除免赔额后支付给投保农户的款项；灾后报告给出的是县级初步估计；灾害救助计划记录的是支付款项而非损失；早期研究也面临同样的困难。 这些记录支持百分比估计的能力远强于精确的美元分析，而对于需要美元数字的用户，模型也可按需给出一个数值，其精度为数量级层面并附带明确说明：在有赔付记录超过10万美元的215个县月中，回溯模型在92%的案例中落在赔付金额十倍以内，在81%的案例中落在五倍以内；日估计分别为83%和66%；而对于中等强度事件，日估计通常不足赔付金额的四分之一。 占预期季度价值的百分比仍是主要答案，因为它可以与用于校准的保险记录进行核对，而美元数字则需要引入暴露数据与价格，其误差会进一步叠加放大。

paragraphs.en: The strength of the models is set by the labels that public data provide. Insured-loss records are available by county, crop group, month and cause, and independent loss records are scarcer, so the checks in this study reach direction and county-scale totals. Better labels, such as farm-level insurance records, adjuster reports or field-verified damage under data agreements with agencies and insurers, would let the same procedure calibrate finer than the county and fit stronger models. Where a state holds records that Florida lacks, such as county loss reports for freezes or field-level flood damage, the same models can be fitted and checked more closely there than in our Florida demonstration. A difference-in-differences (DiD) check on insured losses in nine south-eastern states showed no trend before the storm, a response that rises with wind, rain and their interaction, with the same behaviour in Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina and Alabama, which supports extending the procedure beyond Florida. The three families demonstrated here together account for 64% of weather-caused insured payouts in Florida and 68% across nine south-eastern states (Table 1 ), and each has a weather signal that public archives provide for any date. Excess moisture, with 30% of Florida payouts and 21% across the nine states, is the natural next family: tying its claims to the weather that caused them needs labels finer than the county-month, such as adjuster reports or field-verified flood damage, which other states or agencies may hold, and the procedure applies directly where they do. Hail and non-cyclone wind have loss records and sparser weather inputs, and records of finer scale would extend the framework to them.
paragraphs.zh: 模型的能力上限由公开数据所提供的标签决定。 保险损失记录可按县、作物组、月份和致灾原因获取，而独立的损失记录较为稀缺，因此本研究的验证只能达到方向判断和县级总量层面。 更好的标签，例如与机构和保险公司签订数据协议后获取的农场级保险记录、理算师报告或经田间核实的损害，将使同一流程能够校准到比县更细的尺度，并拟合更强的模型。 在某些州拥有佛罗里达所缺乏的记录的地方，例如霜冻的县级损失报告或田块级洪水损害，可以在那里以比我们佛罗里达示范更细的尺度拟合和检验同样的模型。 对东南部九个州保险损失的双重差分（DiD）检验显示，风暴来临前无趋势，响应随风速、降雨及其交互作用增大，且在佛罗里达、佐治亚、北卡罗来纳、南卡罗来纳和亚拉巴马表现一致，这支持将该流程推广到佛罗里达以外。 本文演示的三大类灾害合计占佛罗里达天气致灾保险赔付的64%，占东南九州的68%（表1），且每一类都有公开档案可为任意日期提供的天气信号。 过度湿润灾害占佛罗里达赔付的30%、占九州赔付的21%，是顺理成章的下一类：将其理赔与致灾天气关联起来需要比县-月更细的标签，例如理算师报告或经田间核实的洪水损害，这类数据其他州或机构可能持有，而在持有这些数据的地方，该流程可直接套用。 冰雹和非旋风大风有损失记录但天气输入较为稀疏，而更细尺度的记录将把该框架扩展到这两类灾害。

paragraphs.en: The study covers the 67 counties of Florida for 2004–2024, the period for which the insured-loss records, the hurricane archive and the gridded weather archives overlap. The hazard index is computed for each county and day, and the loss model is fitted on county × \times crop-group × \times month units, where the eight crop groups (citrus, vegetables, other fruit, sugarcane, cotton, peanuts, grains and oilseeds, tobacco) aggregate the 32 insured commodities present in Florida. The data are of three kinds, weather, agricultural and loss records. For each kind we describe the sources, how they were combined and processed, and what a dataset must provide to replace ours when the workflow is extended to another region or period.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究覆盖佛罗里达州67个县2004至2024年这一时期，即保险损失记录、飓风档案和网格化气象档案同时可得的时段。 危害指数按县和日计算，损失模型在县 × \times 作物组 × \times 月份单元上拟合，其中八个作物组（柑橘、蔬菜、其他水果、甘蔗、棉花、花生、谷物和油料作物、烟草）汇总了佛罗里达州现有的32种受保险商品。 数据分为三类：气象数据、农业数据和损失记录。 对于每一类数据，我们描述其来源、组合与处理方式，以及当工作流程扩展到其他地区或时期时，一个数据集必须提供哪些内容才能替代我们的数据。

Tropical-cyclone winds come from HURDAT2, the only record that resolves the core of a cyclone, and the official forecast of the National Hurricane Center supplies the wind of an Atlantic cyclone that threatens Florida for the five days it covers, with the National Blend of Models for the sixth and seventh, because over 98 storms its county winds differed from the best track by 4 to 6 m s -1 , against 11 to 15 m s -1 for the gusts of the National Blend of Models, which are too weak at the core of a cyclone.

paragraphs.en: The sources are combined by what each can represent. The wind field of a cyclone is rebuilt from the best-track fixes with a radial profile through the reported wind radii [ 67 ] , because reanalyses and forecasts smooth the core of a cyclone and underestimate its winds, and the county value is the 90th percentile of grid-cell maxima, which represents the part of the county the core passed over rather than the county mean. On days without a cyclone within 600 km, wind is the daily maximum gust divided by 1.3 to approximate sustained wind. Rainfall is the county mean of daily totals, log-transformed and standardised, and a standardised precipitation–evapotranspiration index (SPEI) [ 68 ] is computed for each county and calendar month. Where an archive has not yet published a day, rainfall falls back to gridMET and then to the blend and the other variables to the blend, with minimum temperature corrected against PRISM for its warm bias on cold nights. On the map the colour boundaries of each layer are percentiles of its own history, from the median to the 99th.
paragraphs.zh: 各数据源按照各自能表征的内容进行合并。 气旋的风场由最佳路径定位点结合经报告风圈半径的径向廓线重建 [ 67 ]，因为再分析与预报会平滑气旋核心并低估其风速；县值取网格单元最大值的第 90 百分位数，它代表的是核心经过的那部分县域，而非全县平均。 在 600 公里范围内没有气旋的日子里，风速取每日最大阵风除以 1.3 来近似持续风速。 降水为各县日降水量的县均值，经对数变换并标准化；同时为每个县和每个日历月计算标准化降水蒸散指数（SPEI）[ 68 ]。 当某个档案尚未发布某天的数据时，降水回退到 gridMET，再回退到融合数据，其他变量则回退到融合数据，其中最低气温会针对其在寒冷夜晚的偏暖偏差用 PRISM 进行校正。 在地图上，每个图层的颜色分界线取自其自身历史记录的百分位数，从中位数到第 99 百分位数。

paragraphs.en: A replacement weather dataset must be daily, because the index is computed each day and the loss model takes its largest value over 30 days, gridded finer than the county, because a county mean or a 28-km reanalysis smooths away the core of a storm and the cold-air pools, continuous over the period of the loss records, so that the history of every county is comparable across events, and equipped with a forecast counterpart, so that the same index can run for the coming week. Where no finer archive spans the whole period, the next-finest one fills the gap, as ERA5 does for gusts before the HRRR record begins.

paragraphs.en: Loss records. The label of the loss model is the payout, in dollars, recorded by the USDA Risk Management Agency (Table 2 ) by county, commodity and insurance plan. The payout, formally recorded as indemnity, is smaller than the loss in the field because a policy leaves a deductible, a fraction of the crop’s expected value, to the grower and pays only the loss beyond it. RMA also provides other necessary complementary data. The first is the liability, the most a policy can pay, which is the product of the expected value in the field in dollars and the coverage level, where the coverage level is one minus the deductible, given for each deductible that the policies of a unit hold. The second is the cause of loss, of which the weather causes are hurricane, tropical storm and tropical depression, excess moisture, wind and flood, and the hurricane subset is used where stated. The third is the mapping rule of how payouts, recorded by month, relate to liabilities, recorded by harvest year. The panel holds 60,135 units in 50 counties, each a county, commodity, insurance plan and month of loss. The independent checks are in Table 2 .

paragraphs.en: Inversion from payout to damage fraction. RMA payouts could serve as a good calibration target for the loss model, but for broader value and the convenience of users we recover the damage fraction d d , the fraction of the crop’s expected value lost in the field, and use it as the main outcome of WxCrop. RMA states the policy by which payouts are calculated from d d , but predicting d d in the reverse direction is inexact, for reasons such as a zero payout not meaning zero loss in the field. We use bisection to solve this reverse direction from payout to d d . For a unit whose liability is spread over deductibles δ k \delta_{k} in shares w k w_{k} , a damage fraction d d shared by all its insured farms gives the loss cost ∑ k w k ​ max ⁡ { 0 , d − δ k } / ( 1 − δ k ) \sum_{k}w_{k}\max\{0,d-\delta_{k}\}/(1-\delta_{k}) , which rises with d d , so bisection finds the single d d that reproduces the recorded loss cost. A unit with no payout is censored at the lowest deductible among those holding at least 5% of its liability, which treats it as damage below that deductible and not as none. From here on the damage fraction d d is the label on which the loss model is built. To test whether this inversion method is acceptable, we further need to prepare two datasets: (1) years of the loss records held out of the fit, on which the model is tested for reproducing the damage fraction d d on data it has not seen, and (2) an independent record that does not pass through the insurance files, which cross-validates the damage fraction d d itself, for which we use the county citrus production of the Florida Citrus Statistics (Loss model).

paragraphs.en: We consider three questions in turn while building a hazard index: (1) what basic shape, or family of formula, the index should take, (2) how to make sure that the index marks real damage to crops, and (3) which weather factors are effective in indicating loss from the hazard. paragraphs.en: To answer the second question, we compared each county and crop group in the months when the index reached a chosen tier with the same county and crop group in other months and with other counties in the same month, so that the lasting differences between counties and the shocks shared by a month do not distort the comparison. This is a difference-in-differences (DiD) design with two-way fixed effects [ 69 , 70 , 71 , 72 ] , which has been applied to the hurricane losses of insured crops [ 41 ] . Defining the groups by the intensity of the weather, here the tier of the index, avoids the attenuation that simple definitions of exposure cause [ 41 ] . The comparison is made on the damage fraction d d (Data preparation), pooled over crop groups with weights by liability, because the index is built from weather alone to detect whether an agricultural disaster is occurring and this step needs only a directional signal of loss, not the loss of any one crop. The difference in the damage fraction between the two groups is the effect of reaching the tier, so that an effect of 0.1 means a damage fraction 10 percentage points higher, and standard errors are clustered by year. Three results show that the index marks real damage. Damage in the months before the event does not differ between the two groups, the effect rises from tier to tier as the weather becomes more extreme, and the effect predicted by the model itself agrees with the estimate from the comparison. The design is described step by step in the code repository ( docs/CAUSAL_ANALYSIS_DESIGN.md ).
paragraphs.zh: 为回答第二个问题，我们将指数达到选定层级月份中的每个县和作物组，与同一县和作物组在其他月份的情况以及同月其他县的情况进行比较，从而使县之间的持久差异以及某月共同受到的冲击不会扭曲比较结果。 这是一种采用双向固定效应的差异中的差异（DiD）设计 [ 69 , 70 , 71 , 72 ] ，该方法已被应用于投保作物的飓风损失研究 [ 41 ] 。 以天气强度（此处即指数层级）来定义分组，避免了简单暴露定义所导致的衰减 [ 41 ] 。 比较是在损失比例 d d （数据准备）上进行的，并按责任额加权在作物组之间汇总，因为该指数仅由天气数据构建，用于检测农业灾害是否正在发生，而这一步只需要损失的方向性信号，而不需要任何单一作物的损失。 两组之间损失比例的差异即达到该层级的效应，因此效应为 0.1 意味着损失比例高出 10 个百分点，标准误按年份进行聚类。 三项结果表明该指数标记了真实的损失。 事件发生前各月两组之间的损失没有差异，随着天气变得更极端，效应逐级上升，且模型自身预测的效应与通过比较得到的估计值相一致。 该设计在代码仓库（ docs/CAUSAL_ANALYSIS_DESIGN.md ）中逐步进行了说明。

paragraphs.en: To answer the third question, we entered each candidate factor in two ways, as a factor that acts on loss by itself and as one that amplifies or weakens the damage that a tier of the index brings, and we wrote down the direction in which each should act before the run. paragraphs.en: Loss fractions are expressed relative to the expected value of the season’s yield, the basis on which insurance guarantees are set. The loss fraction S g S_{g} and the expected loss L g L_{g} that the assistant reports, and the county loss fractions that the map shows, are on the insurance scale, the damage on the insured units of the group, which is the scale on which the model was calibrated. The county value on the map is the mean of the S g S_{g} of its crop groups weighted by their expected season value. For reference, the insurance-scale damage is about κ = 1.65 \kappa=1.65 times the decline of county production records (95% interval 1.36–2.00), the median ratio over the 268 county-seasons and county-crop-years with a recorded insurance loss and a production decline above 5% (58 of 110 citrus county-seasons and 210 of 10,898 field-crop county-crop-years from Florida, Georgia, Alabama, South Carolina and North Carolina, the five states in which a wind-only response fitted to the other eight south-eastern states reproduced the recorded hurricane losses to within 0.77 to 1.25 times, the latter at county wind of at least 33 m s -1 ), with a bootstrap over event years. Dollar figures, returned on request, multiply P g P_{g} by the expected loss cost under a within-county spread of farm-level damage ( 𝒩 ⁡ ( S g , 0.20 2 ) \mathcal{N}(S_{g},0.20^{2}) , the spread fitted in the full insurance model) and by the annual liability. The full retrospective insurance model, which adds a zero-inflation term, censored likelihood, a citrus liability-to-production ratio and monthly lagged rainfall, is described in the code repository ( docs/INSURANCE_LOSS_MODEL_PAPER_NOTES_2026-10-05.md ), and its county-month estimates serve as the retrospective reference in validation.

paragraphs.en: To judge the model on years it had not seen, we left each of the 21 years out in turn, fitted the model on the others and predicted the year left out. Rank agreement is reported as Spearman correlation or as the proportion of county pairs ordered correctly, totals as ratios of predicted to observed sums, and probabilities by the Brier score and by calibration in ten equal groups. In the insurance panel we report the rank agreement between the predicted loss fraction S g S_{g} and the damage fraction d d in storm months, the ratio of their liability-weighted totals, and the calibration by wind class (18–25, 25–33, 33–42 and ≥ \geq 42 m s -1 ). The rank agreement was 0.40, the ratio of the totals over storm county-months was 1.02, with ratios from 0.82 to 1.24 across the four wind classes and from 0.77 to 1.27 across seven crop groups, and 85% of the 20 largest recorded county-months were predicted within a factor of two. These comparisons are on the insurance scale and use storm county-months with county wind of at least 18 m s -1 , and sugarcane, which has almost no recorded storm loss, is omitted from the crop-group ratios. External checks used records that played no part in fitting the parameters. Two of them, the UF/IFAS loss ratios and the citrus production records, had also guided the choice of index form and of label above. County citrus production shortfalls relative to the previous season, from the Florida Citrus Statistics county tables [ 61 ] , were compared with the citrus percentage by rank correlation, where the percentage is the largest daily conditional citrus loss S S from June to November of the preceding year. County loss ratios from the UF/IFAS reports were compared by the proportion of county pairs ordered correctly across events, which is reported as a descriptive proportion because county pairs that share a county or a storm are dependent. The dollar outputs of the hurricane assessment were checked on all 1,188 county-months with H ≥ 1 H\geq 1 against recorded payouts and the retrospective model. The headline checks are reported as point estimates.

paragraphs.en: The assistant is a language model that works between the user and the tools of the platform, and it never computes or invents a number. From a question it writes a structured request: which quantity, for which county, crop, date and hazard, and which tool answers it, the hazard index, the loss model, the crop map or the weather layers. The platform runs the tools and records each result as a receipt that holds the value, its unit, the data version and the filters applied. The reply is then assembled by the platform from these receipts, and the model words the sentences around them, so every number in an answer traces to one tool call and its sources. A hazard assessment returns two receipts, the index with its tier and the loss by crop group, and a tier is accepted only when it follows from the index value and the tier boundaries. When a request falls outside the tools, the assistant says so instead of estimating, and when the tools cover only part of a request it marks the answer as partial. The platform currently runs on GPT-6 Sol (OpenAI), and the model is a replaceable part: as language models improve, the platform takes up the newest one without any change to the tools, the receipts or the checks, so the assistant advances with them.
paragraphs.zh: 该助手是一个语言模型，在用户与平台的各种工具之间发挥作用，它从不自行计算或编造数字。 针对一个问题，它会写出一份结构化请求：查询哪个量、针对哪个县、哪种作物、哪个日期和哪种灾害，以及由哪个工具来回答——灾害指数、损失模型、作物地图还是天气图层。 平台运行这些工具，并把每个结果记录为一张回执，其中包含数值、单位、数据版本以及所应用的筛选条件。 回答随后由平台根据这些回执组装而成，模型只负责围绕回执组织措辞，因此答案中的每个数字都可以追溯到某一次工具调用及其数据来源。 一次灾害评估会返回两张回执：带等级的指数和按作物组划分的损失；只有当等级是根据指数值和等级边界推导出来时，该等级才会被接受。 当请求超出工具的覆盖范围时，助手会如实说明而不是进行估算；当工具只能覆盖请求的一部分时，它会把答案标记为部分回答。 平台目前运行在 GPT-6 Sol（OpenAI）上，而模型只是一个可替换的部件：随着语言模型的改进，平台会采用最新的模型，而工具、回执或校验都无需任何改动，因此助手也会随之不断进步。
